system.description:
You cause mana underneath the thinnest layer of the ground to explode upward. Select up to 3 Spaces or a Magnitude 1 Area within range. Creatures in targeted spaces take damage equal to [Arcana] and are Stunned on a failed Evasion.

Elemental Spark Effects:

  • Fire: You create a towering pillar of flame. You deal additional damage equal to [Arcana] and cause the space to erupt in flames. Any creature occupying one of these spaces at the start of their corresponding Phase immediately begins Burning on a failed Evasion.
  • Water: You cause a geyser to erupt. Creatures in targeted spaces are Soaked and are pushed 2 Space Airborne and remain there until the start of the next Phase, where they fall harmlessly to the ground and are Dropped.
  • Earth: You spawn a sturdy earthen pillar. Pillars created this way are treated as 2 Space high obstructions, with Durability equal to [2 x Arcana]. Creatures occupying these spaces are lifted into the air atop the pillar.
  • Air: You blow an incredible blast of wind. Creatures occupying these spaces are blown 4 Spaces Airborne and pushed back 2 Spaces.
